learnings: When a model produces a successful initial audit but then fails on formal review due to API errors, the initial assessment should be preserved as evidence rather than discarded
API failures (HTTP 400, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from security-based inconclusive verdicts in the final report summary
For simple packages with only PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, a single successful model review is sufficient for high-confidence verdicts
